fever._note: GDD 8.3. Rates sit at the slow end of the sanctioned ranges (distance 0.03~0.07, coin 0.8~1.6): at the defaults the gauge filled in ~45s, under the 50~70s target, because a coin-heavy line charges far faster than the distance-only sanity check in 8.3 assumes. ~68s now. durationSec 5.0 -> 7.5 (GDD 8.3 revision, user request): five seconds ended before the payoff registered. Tune from measured per-minute distance/coins/near-miss, never by hardcoding elsewhere. | 2026-08-21: durationSec 7.5 -> 9.5 (user request, balance pass).

items._note: Item table (user spec 2026-08-13). placement: risk = near a hazard so the pickup costs a manoeuvre; safe = in a clear stretch; neutral = anywhere. Weights give bigcoin/magnet/bolt 'medium' frequency and shield 'low'. | 2026-08-21: boltFeverChargePct 30 -> 100 (user request). The lightning now fills the gauge outright and fever fires on pickup, so it is a guaranteed payoff rather than a partial top-up. | 2026-08-21: heart added at weight 2 — rarer than the three medium pickups but ahead of the shield, since it is the only way to undo damage.

hp._note: GDD v6.0 §6 (STEP 2). One hit costs one heart and grants invulnerability so a single obstacle cannot eat the whole bar on consecutive frames. A pit costs a heart and returns her to solid ground before it rather than ending the run. §18 leaves these open until play-testing; these are the first pass, not a balanced answer. | 2026-08-21: heart pickup added (user request). max stays the stage-start value; maxCap is the ceiling a pickup can raise it to, and the item stops spawning at the cap.
